subject: Next steps & procurement path (AWS Marketplace interest)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's call

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap:
- Use case: LumenAI wants to standardize inference for customer-facing features (embedding search + summaries).
- Traffic profile: steady ramp (pilot ~50qps, prod target ~300qps) with strict P95 latency SLAs.
- Data requirements: logs/audit for compliance, customer data separation.

Questions / procurement path (asks):
1) Preferred payment mechanism: do you want to purchase via PO (invoice) or do you have a corporate card for early pilots?
2) Does Procurement require a vendor packet (W9, insurance certs, SOC 2 report)? If so, please share contact.
3) Marketplace interest: are you interested in procuring via AWS Marketplace (or GCP/Azure)? Which would your procurement team prefer to start with?

Proposed next steps:
- I will loop in Sales Ops and Marketplace Partnerships to surface the onboarding checklist and draft MSA.
- If PO is the path, we'll prepare a commercial summary and invoice flow for Procurement.
- If marketplace is preferred, we'll share the AWS listing timeline (~4–6 weeks after legal sign-off) and onboarding checklist.

I've attached our AWS Marketplace checklist from previous listings to give procurement a sense of requirements.

Attachment: AWS_Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx

Would love a quick note from you on the three questions above so we can route internally.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Bill Murray <bill.murray@lumenai.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 19:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's call

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers below: 

1) Procurement path: We are a PO-first organization for new vendors. We will issue an SAP PO once legal approves contract language. Early pilot budgets can sometimes be put on a corporate card but that requires manager sign-off; we'd prefer PO if possible.
2) Vendor packet: yes — procurement@lumenai.com will want W9, COI, and SOC 2. I copied procurement and Bill (finance) on this thread.
3) Marketplace: interested in AWS Marketplace first; we have an internal preference for Marketplace procurement (billing through AWS) but we'll also consider GCP depending on timeline.

Timeline: legal usually runs ~4–8 weeks for a standard MSA review; procurement needs an estimated cost and invoice terms to create the PO.

Next asks for you: can you send a short commercial summary (list price, expected seats/throughput, any pilot discount) and attach your SOC 2 report? Also include any marketplace onboarding docs for AWS.

Best,
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Platform | LumenAI
sasha@lumenai.com
